mapper.sql: select t.*, u2.nick_name as applicant_name, w.warehouse_name as target_warehouse_name from erp_purchase_request t left join sys_user u2 on u2.user_id = t.applicant_id left join erp_warehouse w on w.id = t.target_warehouse_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_purchase_request (request_no, title, applicant_id, required_date, target_warehouse_id, request_reason, estimated_amount, request_status, dept_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{requestNo}, #{title}, #{applicantId}, #{requiredDate}, #{targetWarehouseId}, #{requestReason}, #{estimatedAmount}, #{requestStatus}, #{deptId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_purchase_request where id in #{id}
